latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of teacher-lesson-plans skill.

- Generates UK National Curriculum-aligned lesson plans with detailed structure, including objectives, differentiation, SEND adaptations, and assessment opportunities.
- Provides differentiated worksheets (Foundation, Core, Extension) for all key stages and subjects.
- Produces assessment questions spanning Bloom’s Taxonomy with full mark schemes.
- Offers student report comments tailored to lesson content.
- Supports both quick mode (instant plans) and detailed mode (guided question flow).
- Designed for KS1–KS5, all subjects, and major UK exam boards.
